fact: The central bank's Regulation No. 002/2024 of July 2024 revised the 2017 payment services regulation and defines three kinds of payment institution licensed by the central bank, including e-money issuers that are not banks, microfinance institutions or the post office.
title: Règlement n° 002/2024 portant révision du Règlement n° 001/2017 relatif aux services de paiement et aux activités des établissements de paiement
publisher: Banque de la République du Burundi
